## WasmHostPlatform.canonicalizePath() method

Resolve an existing path through filesystem aliases. Return the input for a missing path and reject other lookup failures. Custom hosts need this method to use an explicit file storage path.

**Signature:**

```typescript
canonicalizePath?(path: string): Promise<string>;
```
